captions.AI Decisional: Routes the process flow to one of several case branches by evaluating free-text conditions through an OpenAI-compatible LLM. The first case the model marks as true wins; otherwise execution falls through to the Default branch (or stops if none is configured).
captions.Acroform Insert Image: Inserts an image into a PDF file. The location where to insert the image is given by the boundaries of an acroform field.
captions.Apply Formula: Apply an excel formula through a range of cells.
captions.Area Mapper: Maps values found in areas to specific keys. Use configurations to define areas, keys and other filters.
captions.Arithmetic Mean: Returns the arithmetic mean of the numbers in the list
captions.Azure Storage: Work with blobs and containers in an Azure Storage account using a reusable credential.
captions.Base64 To File: Converts a Base64 String to File.
captions.Base64 To String: Convert Base64 string to a string
captions.Between: Get all strings that are between two strings in a string
captions.Builder: Builds an XML based on provided specs.
captions.Call API: Call API action enables you to perform REST/HTTP requests to a specified web API to query data from apps and services. You can retrieve, add, delete and update data.
captions.Call API v1: Call API action enables you to perform REST/HTTP requests to a specified web API to query data from apps and services. You can retrieve, add, delete and update data.
captions.Call API v3: Call API action enables you to perform REST/HTTP requests to a specified web API to query data from apps and services. You can retrieve, add, delete and update data.
captions.Call Subprocess: Enable users to use the published processes within another (parent) process. When a parent process calls a child process (subprocess), the child process executes in a sequential manner and once complete, the execution control then transfers to the main parent process. If you want to map input / output variables between process and subprocess go to Input & Output tab.
captions.Check Boolean: Checks if the input is true or false, based on the selection, and throws error otherwise.
captions.Contains: Verify if a string contains a substring
captions.Copy Object: Make a copy of a blob object.
captions.Copy Paste: Copy and paste a cell range from source to destination.
captions.Count Recent Instances: Enable users to retrieve the count of recent instances of a specified list of process template ids. If the status is not specified it returns the count of all types of instances. If no process template id is specified, returns the count from the entire workspace.
captions.Create Folder: Enables you to create a folder within the specified location in a SFTP server.
captions.Create Folder v1: Enables you to create a folder within the specified location in a SFTP server.
captions.Create Workbook: Creates a new workbook with one sheet.
captions.DOCX To HTML: Converts a DOCX file to a HTML string.
captions.Data Store: Perform row-level operations on a Data Store table: insert, select, update, or delete rows.
captions.Date Difference: Computes the difference between two DateTime values. [ year, quarter, month, week, day ]
captions.DateTime To String: Transform a DateTime to String, using a default format specification.
captions.DeDuplicate: Identify duplicates in a simple list (not data model), based on criteria
captions.Decisional: Decisional activity executes one of several branches, depending on whether a specified condition is met. The first condition evaluated as True determines the next action to be processed within the process.
captions.Decrypt From AES256: Decrypts encrypted text data using the AES algorithm and an AES key length of 256 bits.
captions.Delay: Delay action suspends the execution of the process for a specified amount of time.
captions.Delete Bulk: Deletes multiple files based on an input list of SFTPFilesInformation.
captions.Delete File: Enables you to delete a file within a specified folder from a SFTP server.
captions.Delete File v1: Enables you to delete a file within a specified folder from a SFTP server.
captions.Delete Folder: Enables you to delete a folder within the specified location from a SFTP server. All files & folders under the folder being deleted will also be removed.
captions.Delete Folder v1: Enables you to delete a folder within the specified location from a SFTP server. All files & folders under the folder being deleted will also be removed.
captions.Delete Object: Delete a blob object from an Azure storage container.
captions.Delete Sheet: Deletes a sheet by name from an existing workbook.
captions.Delete by Keys: Delete S3 objects from an Amazon S3 bucket.
captions.Delete by Prefix: Delete blob objects from an Azure storage container.
captions.Download Bulk: Downloads multiple files based on an input list of SFTPFilesInformation.
captions.Download File: Enables you to download a file from a SFTP server.
captions.Download File v1: Enables you to download a file from a SFTP server.
captions.Encrypt To AES256: Encrypts plaintext data using the AES algorithm and an AES key length of 256 bits.
captions.Ends With: Verify if a string ends with a specified string
captions.Execute Command: Execute a custom SQL Command on the target database.
captions.Execute Command V1: Execute a custom SQL Command on the target database.
captions.Execute Query: Execute a custom SQL Query on the target database.
captions.Execute Query V1: Execute a custom SQL Query on the target database.
captions.Execute Query V2: Execute a custom SQL Query on the target database.
captions.Export To CSV: Exports a list (of primitives/simple or of data model) to a .csv file, with export options
captions.Export To XLSX: Exports a list (of primitives/simple or of data model) to a .xlsx file
captions.Extract Embedded Files: Extracts embedded files from a Pdf.
captions.Extract List: Enables you to extract a list of values from a JSON.
captions.Extract Objects: Enables you to extract a single value or a list of values from a JSON.
captions.Extract Text: Extracts text from a .pdf file, in a structured format.
captions.File To Base64: Reads the content of a file into a Base64 string.
captions.File To JSON: Reads the content of a json file into a json variable.
captions.File To String: Reads the content of a file into a string variable.
captions.Filter: Filter a list based on criteria
captions.Find Duplicates: Identify duplicates in a list based on criteria
captions.For Each: For Each action enables you to run a specific action (or set of actions) repeatedly, as long as a condition is met.  This action can be useful to step through all the elements of a process variable (lists only) and iterate through the data and process each information (row) individually.
captions.Form Trigger: Create a form instance by form template.
captions.Format DateTime: Transform a DateTime to String, using a custom format specification.
captions.GUID Converter: Converts a Guid between its standard text form, the 0x hex literal PROCESIO stores, a decimal number, and Base64, in both byte orders.
captions.Generate Document: Generate a document using a Document Designer template.
captions.Generate Integer: Generates a random Integer in between the specified limits.
captions.Generate String: Generates a random String based on the specified settings.
captions.Get Day: Extracts the day from a DateTime.
captions.Get Day Of Week: Returns the index of the day of the week for a DateTime.
captions.Get Element: Returns the value of the given index
captions.Get File Data: Get File Data action enables users to pull in tabular data from an Excel/CSV file and map it to a process variables (type = list of data models). This will allow them to use data coming from external files in process flows.
captions.Get File List: List files names within a folder from a SFTP server. Diplays files name, path, type and size.
captions.Get File List v1: List files names within a folder from a SFTP server. Diplays files name, path, type and size.
captions.Get Hour: Extracts the hour from a DateTime.
captions.Get Index: Reports the zero-based index of the first occurrence of the specified character in this string.
captions.Get Instance Outputs: Enable users to retrieve the Output Variables of a Process Instance based on its InstanceId.
captions.Get Last Used Row: Retrieves the index of the last used row in a given sheet.
captions.Get Metadata: Retrieve metadata for a S3 object from the Amazon S3 bucket.
captions.Get Minute: Extracts the minute from a DateTime.
captions.Get Month: Extracts the month from a DateTime.
captions.Get Named Range: Searches for a named range in an existing workbook and returns its properties.
captions.Get Object: Get a blob object from an Azure storage, downloading it as a file.
captions.Get Recent Instances: Enable users to retrieve the recent instances of a specific process. If the status is not specified it returns all types of instances.
captions.Get Sheet Names: Get all sheet names from an existing workbook.
captions.Get Week Number: Returns the week number for a DateTime. The week number indicates where the week falls numerically within a year.
captions.Get Year: Extracts the year from a DateTime.
captions.HTML Manipulation: HTML Manipulation enables you to update an HTML input using XPath.
captions.HTML To JSON: Converts HTML input into JSON output.
captions.HTML To PDF: Converts HTML input to a PDF file.
captions.Has Elements: Checks if a list is not null or empty, and throws error otherwise.
captions.Hash: Hashes a File or a String based on the specified algorithm.
captions.Hash Mac: Hashes a File or a String based on the specified algorithm and a credential key.
captions.Insert Sheet: Insert a new sheet into an existing workbook.
captions.Is Valid: Validates if a string is a valid JSON or JArray. A successful action status indicates the JSON or JArray is valid and well-formed.
captions.Is Weekday: Checks if a date is on a weekday. Returns true or false.
captions.Is Weekend: Checks if a date is on a weekend. Returns true or false.
captions.JSON To HTML: Converts JSON input into HTML output.
captions.JSON To XML: Converts a JSON input to an XML output.
captions.Join: Concatenates the members of a collection, using the specified separator between each member.
captions.Key Value: Extract the Key & Value from a JSON
captions.Length: Returns the list's number of elements
captions.List Correlation: Computes the correlation coefficient between two lists of numbers.
captions.List Difference: Get the difference of two lists. [First - Second]
captions.List Intersection: Get the intersection of two lists.
captions.List Keys: List S3 object keys from an Amazon S3 bucket.
captions.List Mode: Returns the most frequent value from a list of elements.
captions.List Objects: List S3 objects from an Amazon S3 bucket.
captions.List Standard Deviation: Computes the standard deviation for a list of numbers.
captions.List To File: Writes a list of objects to file.
captions.List To String: Convert any list of objects to a string
captions.List Variance: Computes the variance for a list of numbers.
captions.Map Data: Assign any value to a process variable, value that can be used as an input in another action.
captions.Mapper: XML Mapper enables you to extract a value or a list of values from an XML string or file.
captions.Max: Returns the maximum value from a list of numbers
captions.Median: Returns the median value from a list of numbers
captions.Merge Files: Merges two .pdf files into one. Page order will be same as input file order.
captions.Min: Returns the minimum value from a list of numbers
captions.Modulo: Modulo operation for two integers. Returns the reminder of the division.
captions.Move Bulk: Moves multiple files based on an input list of SFTPFilesInformation.
captions.Move File: Enables you to move a file from one folder to another, or from one SFTP server to another.
captions.Move File v1: Enables you to move a file from one folder to another, or from one SFTP server to another.
captions.Move Object: Copy and remove a S3 object.
captions.Normalize Diacritics: Removes diacritical marks from text characters, converting them to their basic Latin alphabet equivalents. For example, 'é' becomes 'e', 'ă' becomes 'a', etc.
captions.Null Or Empty: Indicates whether the specified string is null or empty.
captions.Object Exists: Check if Azure object is found in the Azure storage.
captions.Object To String: Convert any object to a string
captions.Parse OLE Date: Tries to parse a datetime value from an OLE representation.
captions.Prelude: Send and check phone verification codes (OTP) and look up phone numbers using the Prelude API.
captions.Processor: Returns a list of strings that contains the substrings in this instance that are delimited by element of a specified string
captions.Put Object: Upload a file to an Amazon S3 bucket, storing it as a S3 object.
captions.Query Store: Run MySQL statements against the workspace Data Store: select, insert, update, or delete rows.
captions.Read Files Content: This action reads the content of a list of files, including simple text files, XML, and JSON formats, and returns a data model that contains the content of each file as a string. While it is primarily designed to handle these specific file types, it is important to note that certain other file types, such as PDFs, may not be returned correctly due to differences in encoding. As a result, the action may encounter issues with properly interpreting and converting the content of these files.
captions.Read MSG File: Reads the content of an Outlook .msg file, including attachments.
captions.Read Mailbox V2: The ReadEmailV2 is a temporary action using API OAuth credentials for SMTP authentication.
captions.Read Range: Reads values and formulas from a given excel range.
captions.Read Range from CSV: Reads values from a CSV file using the same configuration as the Excel Read Range action.
captions.RegEx Extract: Returns a list of values based on the RegEx validation
captions.RegEx Replace: Replace values within a string based on RegEx expression
captions.RegEx Validate: Validate string based on RegEx expression
captions.Remove: Remove a given object from a list
captions.Remove Pages: Removes a selection of pages from a pdf and returns the leftover pages as a new pdf.
captions.Rename File/Folder: Enables you to rename a file or a folder within a specified location from a SFTP server.
captions.Rename File/Folder v1: Enables you to rename a file or a folder within a specified location from a SFTP server.
captions.Rename Sheet: Renames a sheet from an existing workbook.
captions.Replace: Searches a string for a specified value and returns a new string where the specified value(s) are replaced
captions.Replace EOL: Replace string \n and \r and \t with their coresponding ASCII characters for new line and tab, or the other way around.
captions.Round: Round a number to the specified number of digits
captions.Round Down: Round down a number to the specified number of digits
captions.Round Up: Round up a number to the specified number of digits
captions.Sanitizer: Sanitize html input string to prevent Html Injection
captions.Select Pages: Selects pages from a pdf and returns them in the order of selection, as a new pdf.
captions.Send Email: Use this action to send emails to as many recipients needed, with/without attachments. You can also use process variables while configuring the Email to easily access your data coming from processing.
captions.Similarity Search: Search a string in a list of strings by estimating the similarity
captions.Simple Filter: Filter a simple list based on criteria
captions.Sort: Sorting a list in descending or ascending order
captions.Sort Data Model: Sorts a data model list based on multiple criteria
captions.Split: Returns a list of strings that contains the substrings in this instance that are delimited by element of a specified string.
captions.Split Workbook: Split an input workbook into multiple workbooks based on a given row number.

captions.Starts With: Verify if a string starts with a specified string

captions.String To JSON: Parses the content of a string into a Json.

captions.Sublist: Extracts a sublist from the given list starting at the specified index and spanning the specified length.
captions.Substring: Retrieves a substring, the substring starts at a specified character position.
captions.Sum: Sums up all the numbers of a list
captions.Take From Left: Returns a substring from the beginning of a specified string
captions.Take From Middle: Returns a segment of a string
captions.Take From Right: Returns a substring from the end of a specified string
captions.Temperature Converter: Converts temperature from one scale to another.
captions.Throw: Throws a custom exception when this action is reached.
captions.Time Difference: Computes the difference between two DateTime values. [ hour, minute, second ]

captions.Trigger Subprocess: Enable users to trigger another process. When a parent process calls a child process (subprocess), the child process is executed asynchronously, meaning it runs independently of the parent process. The parent process continues its execution without waiting for the child process to complete. If you want to map input variables for the subprocess, go to the Input section.
captions.Trim: The white spaces are removed from a string, at the beginning and at the end of the string.
captions.Trim End: The white spaces are removed from a string, at the end of the string.
captions.Trim Start: The white spaces are removed from a string, at the beginning of the string.
captions.URL Decode: Returns a decoded string of an URL encoded one.
captions.URL Encode: Returns an URL encoded value of a string.
captions.UTC Now: Gets the current date & time in UTC standard.
captions.Unrar: Extracts a list of files from a rar archive.
captions.Untar: Extracts a list of files from a tarball.
captions.Unzip: Extracts a list of files from a zip archive.
captions.Update: XML Update enables you to update an XML input, if the input tag exists, or to insert the input tag, if it doesn't exist, using XPath.
captions.Update DateTime: Updates a specific subdivision of a DateTime.
captions.Upload File: Enables you to upload a file on a SFTP server.
captions.Word Mail Merge: Assign specified values to Mail Merge Fields from a word document.
captions.XLS To XLSX: Convert an XLS file to an XLSX file. Styles will not be ported and the maximum permitted size for the XLS file is 10 Mb.
captions.XML To JSON: Converts an XML input to a JSON output.
captions.Zip: Compress a list of files into a zip archive.
